title: Advancing Cognitive Pairwise Comparisons for Human-Centric Artificial Intelligence and Data Science: A Human-in-the-Loop Framework
abstract: arXiv:2611.20926v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Human-centric artificial intelligence and data science (HCAD) systems increasingly involve human-in-the-loop (HITL) interventions to overcome the limitations of fully automated machine learning algorithms, such as automation bias and the inability to incorporate tacit domain knowledge, and continuously improve predictive performance. Data transformations, feature selection, feature weighting, and model selection usually require laborious human involvement across iterations of artificial intelligence and data science (AI&DS) pipelines, making development a challenging and time-consuming process. The Cognitive Pairwise Comparison (CPC) framework is proposed as a human-centric methodology to elicit preferences and priorities in a structured format. To establish essential facets of human-centricity, this research advances the CPC methodology so that user preference elicitation can be systematically quantified in these challenging AI&DS tasks

translated_title: 面向以人为本的人工智能与数据科学的认知成对比较方法进展：一个“人在回路”框架
translated_abstract: 以人为本的人工智能与数据科学系统日益涉及“人在回路”（HITL）干预，以克服完全自动化机器学习算法的局限性，例如自动化偏见以及无法融入隐性领域知识，并持续提升预测性能。数据转换、特征选择、特征加权和模型选择通常需要在人工智能与数据科学（AI&DS）流程的多次迭代中进行费力的人工参与，使得开发过程充满挑战且耗时。本文提出了认知成对比较（CPC）框架作为一种以人为本的方法论，以结构化的格式引出用户的偏好与优先级。为了确立以人为本的关键要素，本研究对CPC方法论进行了推进，使得用户偏好的引出能够在这些具有挑战性的AI&DS任务中得到系统化的量化。
tldr: 本研究推进了认知成对比较（CPC）框架，使以人为本的人工智能与数据科学系统能够在“人在回路”流程中系统化地量化用户偏好，从而克服完全自动化机器学习算法的局限性。
